A '''vibrosaw''' or '''vibro-saw''' was a cutting implement similar to a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]]<ref name="The Unknown Regions" /> that used ultrasonic vibrations to increase cutting power. It was a powered version of a basic saw.<ref name="SWS" /> It was manufactured by [[Greel Wood Logging Corporation]]<ref name="Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear" /> and used mostly in construction works and to cut down [[greel tree]]s and other large vegetation. It was also used to breach [[Hull/Legends|hulls]] and bulkheads during boarding actions by military and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] forces. The vibrosaw was difficult to wield properly as a weapon because it was so large and cumbersome, however, some individuals such as [[Xenon Nnaksta]] made effective use of them in [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee combat]]. Since the vibrosaw was viewed as a tool, it was legal to own one and not as restricted as other [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]].<ref name="The Unknown Regions" />
